title.narrative: Civil Society Advancing Beneficial Ownership Transparency (CSABOT)

description.narrative: Civil Society Advancing Beneficial Ownership Transparency (CSABOT) implements the “Preparatory action – Capacity building programmatic development and communication in the context of the fight against money laundering and financial crimes”. The activities will support capacity building of civil society actors across the EU and contribute to policy development as well as regional and global advocacy related to beneficial ownership transparency. The Network of Experts on Beneficial Ownership Transparency (NEBOT) is one of the project’s key components, bringing together 31 academics, civil society organisations, journalists and other experts with an interest in BOT, including obliged entities and public authorities, with the goals of:- improving the exchange of knowledge on EU anti-money laundering/ counter-terrorism financing (AML/CFT) policies- deepening the understanding of key issues in accessing and using beneficial ownership information to tackle money laundering and financial crime- promoting engagement, cooperation and networking tools on BOT and AML/CFT prevention- developing and improving tools and instruments to further the fight against money laundering and financial crime, mainly on BOT by developing policy positions and written contributionsValue of contract: EUR 727,850

participating-org.narrative: European Commission - Financial Stability, Financial Services and Capital Markets Union (FISMA)
